en: Sepia-toned photograph mounted like a postcard, showing three people in front of a rustic wooden log house. An elderly woman sits on a bench wearing a knitted sweater, long skirt, and white cap. Beside her stand two girls in elaborate traditional folk costumes: long patterned dresses with embroidered bibs, white blouses with wide sleeves, aprons, and distinctive white headdresses. The scene appears rural and early 20th century.
